AI model cards in carbon.txt and an AI Sustainability Directory
sources.snippet: Using AI Model cards in carbon.txt to disclose training emissions The updated carbon.txt syntax (version 0.5) includes a new organisational disclosure document type - doc_type: 'ai-model-card'. Using this document type, along with a URL of model card (README.md) makes a valid disclosure for training of AI models.
